veranderings.voor: In Graad 5 het jy 'n lampie laat brand met 'n sel en twee drade.
veranderings.na: In Graad 5 het jy met 'n sel en twee drade 'n lampie laat brand.
veranderings.rede: The means phrase sits more naturally before the object and verb cluster in Afrikaans.
'lê gestoor' is a slightly stiff combination; the plain passive is clearer for Grade 6.
AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: en weer terug na die sel
veranderings.rede: 'weer terug' is pleonastic; 'terug' already carries the meaning.
A comma before the concessive 'al'-clause aids reading and matches 'Anders bly die pad oop, al raak hulle.' later in the lesson.

veranderings.voor: Dit is 'n geslote stroombaan en die lampie brand.
veranderings.na: Dit is 'n geslote stroombaan, en die lampie brand.
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Dit is 'n oop stroombaan en die lampie is dood.
veranderings.na: Dit is 'n oop stroombaan, en die lampie brand nie.
veranderings.rede: 'is dood' is colloquial for a lamp; 'brand nie' is standard and mirrors 'die lampie brand' in the closed case; also adds the AWS comma.

veranderings.voor: wat aan mekaar kan raak en weer kan wegbeweeg
veranderings.na: wat mekaar kan raak en weer van mekaar kan wegbeweeg
veranderings.rede: 'mekaar raak' matches the next sentence, and 'wegbeweeg' needs 'van mekaar' to say what the parts move away from.

veranderings.voor: Dit is vinniger om te teken as prente van die regte dele.
veranderings.na: Dit is vinniger om te teken as om prente van die regte dele te maak.
veranderings.rede: The comparison is incomplete: 'om te teken as prente' compares an action with a thing.

veranderings.voor: al is die regte drade krom
veranderings.na: al is die werklike drade krom
veranderings.rede: 'regte' next to 'reguit lyne' can be read as 'straight' (a 'regte lyn' is a straight line); 'werklike' is unambiguous.

veranderings.voor: twee reguit lyne langs mekaar met die een langer as die ander
veranderings.na: twee reguit lyne langs mekaar, waarvan een langer as die ander is
veranderings.rede: 'met die een langer as die ander' is a loose, English-like absolute construction; a relative clause reads more naturally.
Afrikaans compounds are written as one word; no hyphen is needed here.
'los 'n gaping' calques English 'leaves a gap'; Afrikaans says 'laat 'n gaping'.

vlae.teks: In 'n geslote diagram loop die lyn dus sonder 'n gaping
vlae.rede: 'n geslote diagram' is loose shorthand for 'the diagram of a closed circuit'; spelling it out would push the sentence to about 27 words, so it is left for the reviewer or writer to judge.
